svg.desc: Printable reference for VisiData 3.5, Plaso supertimelines, source filtering, pivot tables, and Timeline Explorer artifact colors
svg.text: Controls the ordinary canvas, not the forensic colors.
n / N = next / previous search match
select regex matches in active column
unselect regex matches in active column

On datetime, press gu, then | and enter ^2023-01-
Press Enter, then " to open January 1–31, 2023.
mark current column as a key
frequency grouped by all key columns
2. Move to type and press Shift+W
fit all / set width for all
Timeline Explorer artifact colors (Plaso desc cell)
Only the Plaso desc cell is colored.
No extra Event ID color rules.
For large timelines: Shift+F → mark keys with ! → gF or Shift+W.
